title: Convert validated fixed logical fidelity through an actual retired private Pauli key
statement: For a fixed logical CPTP channel, fresh uniform pre/post Pauli controls and actual key retirement give a Pauli mixture with identity weight F_e and reduced half-diamond error1-F_e. The validated .999 target therefore gives<=.001 on the same simultaneous good event, plus any separately warranted implementation error.

evidence.quote: Let L be the actual fixed one-qubit logical CPTP channel after the acquired frames, encoder, physical noise and known decoder have been fixed. Suppose its independently validated entanglement fidelity obeys F_e(L)>=1-epsilon. For each subsequent use choose P uniformly from {I,X,Y,Z}, independently of inputs, source and all other trials. body: This is simulation with trusted stationary independent sources and ideal preparation, encoding, controls, readout and disposal, not hardware. Unencoded comparisons cover only the ten same-learned-inverse receivers, not all CPTP recovery or equal-rate resources. Two fresh private bits and trusted Pauli controls are required for the derived twirl, whose deployment was not executed. No generic continuing memory, source-bath bound, capacity or threshold follows. Read the exact supporting statement and its applicable conditions. Producer review status is preserved; no new scientific audit or producer-code execution was performed for this insertion.

review.scope: Acquired completed substantive independent review accepts the executed ideal stationary-source simulation and separately derived twirl at their exact source hashes. It closes the older pending author header only at that scope.
